title: Broadcast herdability of stochastic swarm densities
container-title: Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation
abstract: Introduces broadcast herdability for stochastic swarm densities and conditional Fokker-Planck Lyapunov mass bounds for simultaneous target and safety requirements under a shared low-dimensional cue.
keyword: broadcast herdability; common-input swarm control; stochastic swarm densities; Fokker-Planck control; mean-field control; probability mass constraints
